payload.reason: The evidence provides specific references to previous works that the current research is comparing against, particularly in the context of morphological information in translation models.

claims.text: Previous work has integrated morphological information in both Statistical Machine Translation (SMT) and Neural Machine Translation (NMT), including methods that utilize word-level annotations and morphological features.
The research compares its method to previous approaches that model inflection through neural methods and those that predict morphological tags and lemmas.
The study also contrasts its results with baseline systems that use subword and fully character-based methods, demonstrating improvements in translation accuracy.
